paragraphs.en: In October 2025, Beijing imposed sweeping controls on its rare earth exports. Since then, those controls have been suspended one short reprieve at a time , in the latest instance until Nov. 10 , with a broader trade truce through Jan. 10, 2027 . The reprieves have repeatedly come only after American concessions, demonstrating China’s leverage in the export fight.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年10月，北京对其稀土出口实施了大规模管制。 此后，这些管制措施被一次又一次地短暂暂停，最近一次延长至11月10日，同时更广泛的贸易休战将持续至2027年1月10日。 这些宽限一再只在美国作出让步之后才出现，显示出中国在出口战中的筹码。

sents.en: In October 2025, Beijing imposed sweeping controls on its rare earth exports.
sents.zh: 2025年10月，北京对其稀土出口实施了大规模管制。

sents.en: Since then, those controls have been suspended one short reprieve at a time , in the latest instance until Nov. 10 , with a broader trade truce through Jan. 10, 2027 .
sents.zh: 此后，这些管制措施被一次又一次地短暂暂停，最近一次延长至11月10日，同时更广泛的贸易休战将持续至2027年1月10日。

sents.en: The reprieves have repeatedly come only after American concessions, demonstrating China’s leverage in the export fight.
sents.zh: 这些宽限一再只在美国作出让步之后才出现，显示出中国在出口战中的筹码。

paragraphs.en: Yet China has constricted sales even during the truce, as buyers have few options but to take what they can get. In June, with the suspension in force, Beijing placed MP Materials and USA Rare Earth, the two companies the U.S. is counting on to build an alternative supply to China, on an export control list .
paragraphs.zh: 然而在休战期间，中国仍收紧了销售，因为买家别无选择，只能有什么就接受什么。 六月，在暂停措施生效期间，北京将 MP Materials 和 USA Rare Earth——这两家美国指望其建立替代中国供应链的公司——列入了出口管制清单。

sents.en: Yet China has constricted sales even during the truce, as buyers have few options but to take what they can get.
sents.zh: 然而在休战期间，中国仍收紧了销售，因为买家别无选择，只能有什么就接受什么。

sents.en: In June, with the suspension in force, Beijing placed MP Materials and USA Rare Earth, the two companies the U.S. is counting on to build an alternative supply to China, on an export control list .
sents.zh: 六月，在暂停措施生效期间，北京将 MP Materials 和 USA Rare Earth——这两家美国指望其建立替代中国供应链的公司——列入了出口管制清单。

paragraphs.en: Washington’s effort to rebuild the supply chain, meanwhile, has not yet reached the scale or durability the problem requires. With up to $100 billion in loan authority specifically earmarked for critical minerals in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, the capital undoubtedly exists. What is missing is alignment of interests among the parties that would supply and benefit from it, and a political system patient enough to hold a course for the decade or more that rebuilding a supply chain takes.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，华盛顿重建供应链的努力尚未达到该问题所需的规模和持久性。 《大而美法案》中专门为关键矿产划拨了高达1000亿美元的贷款授权，资金无疑是存在的。 缺失的是供应方与受益方之间的利益协调，以及一个足够有耐心的政治体系，能够坚持推进重建供应链所需的十年或更长的历程。

paragraphs.en: This article’s authors work at the intersection of finance and national security. Between the three of us, we have watched the same on-again, off-again rhythm play out in both Chinese statecraft and U.S. budget fights. A consistent pattern plays out: Capital markets are good at financing efficient supply but are not good at financing a binary outcome, such as insurance against a monopoly state seller that can manipulate both price and availability. And subsidies alone will not close that gap. We have seen firsthand that what the U.S. government has to offer right now insufficiently incentivizes private investors, because its tools are market tools deployed in an environment of market failure. Instead, we propose a financing instrument that could clear both economic and political hurdles: a contingent convertible security that converts into ownership if Beijing weaponizes supply.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的作者们工作于金融与国家安全的交汇领域。 就我们三人而言，我们在中国的治国方略和美国的预算斗争中，都目睹了同样的时断时续的节奏反复上演。 一个一贯的模式不断上演：资本市场擅长为高效的供给融资，却不擅长为二元结果融资，例如针对一个能够同时操纵价格和供应的垄断国家卖方的保险。 而仅靠补贴无法弥合这一缺口。 我们亲眼看到，美国政府目前所能提供的条件不足以激励私人投资者，因为其工具是在市场失灵的环境下使用的市场工具。 相反，我们提出一种既能跨越经济障碍又能跨越政治障碍的融资工具：一种或有可转换证券，如果北京将供应武器化，它就转换为所有权。

paragraphs.en: The history of how we got here is well known, but worth retelling briefly. The Chinese Communist Party inherited its strategic focus on building industrial capacity from the Soviet Union. In 1964, Deng Xiaoping inspected an iron ore mine near the Mongolian border holding the world’s largest rare earth deposit. He ordered the engineers to develop steel and rare earths alike. Since then, as technologies have increasingly relied on specialized materials, the Chinese Communist Party under successive leaders has deliberately invested in and consolidated control over the rare earths industry. China refines more than 90 percent of the world’s rare earths and close to 99 percent of heavy rare earths today. It processes nearly all the heavy elements that go into precision-guided weapons and advanced chips.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何走到今天这段历史广为人知，但值得简要重述一番。 中国共产党从苏联继承了对建设工业能力的战略重点。 1964年，邓小平视察了中蒙边境附近一座铁矿，那里拥有世界上最大的稀土矿藏。 他指示工程师们钢铁与稀土并重开发。 此后，随着技术日益依赖特种材料，中国共产党在历届领导人的带领下，刻意投资并巩固了对稀土产业的控制。 如今，中国精炼着全球90%以上的稀土以及接近99%的重稀土。 精确制导武器和先进芯片所需的重稀土元素几乎全部在中国加工。

paragraphs.en: When Beijing tightened export controls in October 2025, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent characterized it as “pointing a bazooka at the supply chains and industrial base of the entire free world.” Remarkably, the entire market for rare earth oxides is worth less than $10 billion. That a $10 billion market can grind to a halt trillions in global gross domestic product is the definition of a chokepoint. Beijing controls this chokepoint today by design. Decades of state policy work laid the groundwork for the Chinese Communist Party to enact an international licensing system by 2025. General Secretary Xi Jinping himself openly speaks about the importance of maintaining global dependency on China’s industrial supply chains.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年10月北京收紧出口管制时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特将其形容为“把火箭筒对准了整个自由世界的供应链和工业基础”。值得注意的是，稀土氧化物的整个市场规模还不到100亿美元。 一个100亿美元的市场竟能使数万亿美元的全球国内生产总值陷入停摆，这正是“咽喉要道”的定义。 如今北京是有意掌控着这一咽喉要道。 数十年的国家政策工作为中国共产党在2025年前建立国际许可制度奠定了基础。 习近平总书记本人公开谈及维持全球对中国工业供应链依赖的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Hindsight treats this as neglect, something policymakers lost sight of and let slip during the U.S.’s unipolar moment. That is a necessary, but only partial, explanation. The truth is the United States did not lose its rare earth industry due to carelessness. Private American companies willingly sold it, for reasons that made perfect economic sense at the time and still do. China bought it for reasons that were never purely economic. That mismatch explains why, after years of investment and policy attention, the dependency remains.
paragraphs.zh: 事后来看，这被视为一种疏忽，是美国在单极时刻中 policymakers（决策者）忽视并放任流失的东西。 这是一种必要的解释，但只是部分解释。 事实上，美国并不是因为疏忽大意而失去了其稀土产业。 美国私营企业是心甘情愿将其出售的，其理由在当时完全符合经济逻辑，至今依然如此。 中国收购它的理由从来不是纯粹经济性的。 正是这种错位解释了为什么经过多年的投资和政策关注，这种依赖关系依然存在。

paragraphs.en: Until the late 1980s, the United States was the world’s leading producer and refiner of rare earths. But it was a dirty business: The Mountain Pass mine in California leaked roughly 600,000 gallons of radioactive and other waste into the Mojave. As cleanup and regulatory costs mounted and profits fell, the mine shut down in stages starting in the 1990s until it was fully idle by 2002. Meanwhile, the work moved to China, where the state subsidized unprofitable operations, tolerated pollution, and sold the processed oxides back to the U.S. at rock-bottom prices.
paragraphs.zh: 直到20世纪80年代末，美国一直是世界上主要的稀土生产国和精炼国。 但这是一门肮脏的生意：加利福尼亚州的芒廷帕斯矿向莫哈韦沙漠泄漏了约60万加仑放射性及其他废弃物。 随着清理和监管成本不断攀升、利润不断下滑，该矿从20世纪90年代开始逐步关停，到2002年已完全闲置。 与此同时，这项工作转移到了中国，在那里，国家补贴亏损的运营业务，容忍污染，并以极低的价格将加工后的氧化物卖回美国。

sents.zh: 直到20世纪80年代末，美国一直是世界上主要的稀土生产国和精炼国。

paragraphs.en: The same thing happened to the magnets: In 1995, General Motors sold Magnequench , its magnet unit, to a Chinese-backed consortium. By 2006, the last U.S. plant had closed, and the machine tools and equipment had been shipped to China. Economists would say this was the right move for a free market economy. Comparative advantage did what it was supposed to do, and a dirty, low-margin business left a wealthy country for a developing one. There was even a strategic rationale: Drawing China into the trading system, the wishful thinking went, would also make it a responsible stakeholder rather than a rival.
paragraphs.zh: 磁体行业也发生了同样的事情：1995 年，通用汽车将其磁体部门麦格昆磁出售给一个由中国支持的财团。 到 2006 年，美国最后一家工厂关闭，机床和设备被运往中国。 经济学家会说，这对自由市场经济来说是正确的举措。 比较优势发挥了它应有的作用，一个污染严重、利润微薄的行业离开富裕国家，转向了发展中国家。 甚至还有一种战略上的理由：一厢情愿的想法是，把中国拉入贸易体系，也会让它成为负责任的利益相关者，而非对手。

sents.en: There was even a strategic rationale: Drawing China into the trading system, the wishful thinking went, would also make it a responsible stakeholder rather than a rival.

paragraphs.en: The category error was to conceive rare earths as a market, rather than recognizing it as a geostrategic industry. A market solves for the lowest cost. To be sure, Chinese producers competed on cost, and they rode a tech boom with surging demand for their product. But a state will pay almost any price to control a chokepoint, because tolerating a money-losing business pales in comparison to the geopolitical leverage that it brings. Over time, China has become less market driven, not more. Meanwhile, the U.S. continued to treat as a market what the Chinese Communist Party came to appreciate as a strategic program.
paragraphs.zh: 这一范畴错误在于把稀土视为一个市场，而没有认识到它是一个地缘战略产业。 市场追求的是最低成本。 诚然，中国生产商在成本上展开竞争，并且乘着科技繁荣的浪潮，其产品需求激增。 但一个国家几乎愿意付出任何代价来控制一个咽喉要道，因为容忍一个亏损业务，与它带来的地缘政治杠杆相比微不足道。 随着时间推移，中国变得更少由市场驱动，而不是更多。 与此同时，美国继续把中国共产党逐渐视为战略项目的东西当作市场来对待。

sents.en: The category error was to conceive rare earths as a market, rather than recognizing it as a geostrategic industry.
sents.zh: 这一范畴错误在于把稀土视为一个市场，而没有认识到它是一个地缘战略产业。

sents.en: A market solves for the lowest cost.
sents.zh: 市场追求的是最低成本。

sents.en: To be sure, Chinese producers competed on cost, and they rode a tech boom with surging demand for their product.
sents.zh: 诚然，中国生产商在成本上展开竞争，并且乘着科技繁荣的浪潮，其产品需求激增。

sents.en: But a state will pay almost any price to control a chokepoint, because tolerating a money-losing business pales in comparison to the geopolitical leverage that it brings.
sents.zh: 但一个国家几乎愿意付出任何代价来控制一个咽喉要道，因为容忍一个亏损业务，与它带来的地缘政治杠杆相比微不足道。

sents.en: Over time, China has become less market driven, not more.
sents.zh: 随着时间推移，中国变得更少由市场驱动，而不是更多。

sents.en: Meanwhile, the U.S. continued to treat as a market what the Chinese Communist Party came to appreciate as a strategic program.
sents.zh: 与此同时，美国继续把中国共产党逐渐视为战略项目的东西当作市场来对待。

paragraphs.en: Control over the chokepoint gives Beijing a switch. When it lets the material flow, no private interest will build alternative supply chains at scale, because Chinese state-funded producers can sell at or below cost indefinitely, and no rational private investor will willingly sign up to lose money. When China cuts off the flow, the incentives reverse overnight, but capacity cannot follow overnight, because standing up the full supply chain and rebuilding the lost know-how can take a decade or longer.
paragraphs.zh: 掌控这一咽喉要道，让北京手中握有一个开关。 当它允许材料流通时，不会有私人利益主体大规模建设替代供应链，因为由中国国家资助的生产商可以无限期地以成本价或低于成本价出售，而没有任何理性的私人投资者会心甘情愿地签约亏钱。 当中国切断流通时，激励机制一夜之间逆转，但产能无法一夜跟上，因为建立完整的供应链并重建已流失的专业知识可能需要十年或更长时间。

sents.en: Control over the chokepoint gives Beijing a switch.
sents.zh: 掌控这一咽喉要道，让北京手中握有一个开关。

sents.en: When it lets the material flow, no private interest will build alternative supply chains at scale, because Chinese state-funded producers can sell at or below cost indefinitely, and no rational private investor will willingly sign up to lose money.

paragraphs.en: This is classic market failure in which the same critical material can become worthless or priceless on command. In 2010, during a maritime dispute with Japan, Beijing reportedly halted rare earth shipments , and Tokyo quickly conceded. The short-term truces of the past year, each struck around contentious but episodic trade disputes, further entrench that market failure. Each successive loosening and tightening seems designed to keep the United States and its allies off balance and frustrate any long-term plan to reduce Beijing’s leverage.
paragraphs.zh: 这是典型的市场失灵：同一种关键材料可以随指挥而变得一文不值或价值连城。 2010年，在与日本的海洋争端中，据报道北京暂停了稀土出口，东京很快作出了让步。 过去一年中的多次短期休战，每一次都围绕有争议但属于偶发性的贸易争端达成，进一步巩固了这种市场失灵。 每一次接踵而来的放松与收紧，似乎都旨在让美国及其盟友失去平衡，并挫败任何削弱北京影响力的长期计划。

sents.en: This is classic market failure in which the same critical material can become worthless or priceless on command.
sents.zh: 这是典型的市场失灵：同一种关键材料可以随指挥而变得一文不值或价值连城。

sents.zh: 2010年，在与日本的海洋争端中，据报道北京暂停了稀土出口，东京很快作出了让步。

paragraphs.en: Government Money Has to Survive Politics
paragraphs.zh: 政府的钱必须经受住政治的考验

paragraphs.en: If the market will not rebuild the rare earths supply chain, the government must do so.
paragraphs.zh: 如果市场不会重建稀土供应链，政府就必须这么做。

paragraphs.en: Administrations under both parties have tried, and their attempts have run into a predictable morass of misaligned interests. The parties to government financing all want different things. Private investors want attractive returns in fat years, while having the government carry losses in lean ones. Commercial lenders want years of fully contracted offtake to guarantee interest payments, while Congress typically appropriates money for the next year. Markets want flexibility while Congress wants tight oversight and guardrails. Washington often wants to be the last (and lightest) money in, which signals to investors that the government is hedging. And cheap, open-ended financing is exactly the wrong signal to send to management teams.
paragraphs.zh: 两党政府都曾做过尝试，而它们的努力都陷入了可以预见的利益错位的泥潭。 政府融资的各方想要的东西各不相同。 私人投资者希望在丰年获得可观的回报，同时又让政府在歉年承担亏损。 商业贷款机构想要多年期完全签订的承购合同来保障利息支付，而国会通常只为下一年度拨款。 市场想要灵活性，而国会想要严格监督并设置防护栏。 华盛顿往往想成为最后一个（也是承担最轻的）出资方，这向投资者传递的信号是政府在观望对冲。 而廉价、无限制的融资恰恰是向管理团队传递的错误信号。

sents.en: Administrations under both parties have tried, and their attempts have run into a predictable morass of misaligned interests.
sents.zh: 两党政府都曾做过尝试，而它们的努力都陷入了可以预见的利益错位的泥潭。

sents.en: The parties to government financing all want different things.
sents.zh: 政府融资的各方想要的东西各不相同。

sents.en: Private investors want attractive returns in fat years, while having the government carry losses in lean ones.
sents.zh: 私人投资者希望在丰年获得可观的回报，同时又让政府在歉年承担亏损。

sents.zh: 商业贷款机构想要多年期完全签订的承购合同来保障利息支付，而国会通常只为下一年度拨款。

sents.zh: 市场想要灵活性，而国会想要严格监督并设置防护栏。

sents.en: Washington often wants to be the last (and lightest) money in, which signals to investors that the government is hedging.
sents.zh: 华盛顿往往想成为最后一个（也是承担最轻的）出资方，这向投资者传递的信号是政府在观望对冲。

sents.en: And cheap, open-ended financing is exactly the wrong signal to send to management teams.
sents.zh: 而廉价、无限制的融资恰恰是向管理团队传递的错误信号。

paragraphs.en: The Pentagon’s latest playbook acknowledges that the market, left to its own devices, simply will not finance uneconomic redundancy. As a result, the July 2025 deal with MP Materials includes $400 million in convertible preferred stock, loans, equity warrants, a 10-year guaranteed price floor, and a 10-year offtake commitment. The deal was right for its moment, as it gets the producer going and sustains it while Beijing floods the market. But the deal blurs two different roles: In ordinary years, the government is a lender, financing capacity the market will not; in a crisis, it has insured against a geopolitical event. These two roles call for two different return profiles. Because the deal does not separate them, it puts the government in the unenviable position of simultaneously absorbing losses and inviting the charge of nationalization, all without a clear exit strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 五角大楼的最新行动纲领承认，市场若放任自流，根本不会为不经济的冗余产能提供融资。 因此，2025年7月与MP Materials达成的协议包括4亿美元的可转换优先股、贷款、股权认股权证、一项为期10年的保底价格以及一项为期10年的承购承诺。 这笔交易对当时的时机来说是正确的，因为它让生产商运转起来，并在北京向市场大量倾销期间维持其生存。 但这笔交易混淆了两种不同的角色：在寻常年份，政府是放贷方，为市场不愿融资的产能提供资金；在危机中，它是在对冲地缘政治事件的风险。 这两种角色需要两种不同的回报模式。 由于这笔交易没有将两者区分开来，它使政府陷入了一种尴尬的境地：既在承担损失，又招致国有化的指责，而且还没有明确的退出策略。

sents.zh: 五角大楼的最新行动纲领承认，市场若放任自流，根本不会为不经济的冗余产能提供融资。

paragraphs.en: Without some structure to navigate potentially painful political costs, these financing arrangements will come under pressure during budget cycles and electoral turnover. And that is simply untenable, because when it comes to the decade-plus timeline to stand up a rare earths supply chain, whatever Washington builds must outlast the administration that built it.
paragraphs.zh: 如果缺乏某种结构来应对可能高昂的政治代价，这些融资安排就会在预算周期和选举更替中承受压力。 这根本是站不住脚的，因为建立稀土供应链需要十年以上的时间，华盛顿所建立的一切必须比建立它的政府更长久。

sents.en: Without some structure to navigate potentially painful political costs, these financing arrangements will come under pressure during budget cycles and electoral turnover.
sents.zh: 如果缺乏某种结构来应对可能高昂的政治代价，这些融资安排就会在预算周期和选举更替中承受压力。

paragraphs.en: A Financial Instrument That Responds to Beijing’s Behavior
paragraphs.zh: 一种对北京行为作出反应的金融工具

paragraphs.en: Our proposal is a financial instrument that aligns these interests. In financial parlance, the instrument is called a contingent convertible security, also known as a CoCo bond, issued by the producer to the government and any private lenders who wish to join, paired with guaranteed offtake at a price floor. Its form changes with two externally observable conditions: the producer’s capacity build-out and Beijing’s behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的提案是一种能够协调这些利益的金融工具。 用金融术语来说，这种工具被称为应急可转换证券，也称为 CoCo 债券，由生产方发行给政府以及任何希望参与的私人放贷方，并配以保证在价格下限下的承购。 其形式会随两个外部可观察的条件而变化：生产方的产能建设和北京的行为。

sents.en: Our proposal is a financial instrument that aligns these interests.
sents.zh: 我们的提案是一种能够协调这些利益的金融工具。

sents.en: In financial parlance, the instrument is called a contingent convertible security, also known as a CoCo bond, issued by the producer to the government and any private lenders who wish to join, paired with guaranteed offtake at a price floor.
sents.zh: 用金融术语来说，这种工具被称为应急可转换证券，也称为 CoCo 债券，由生产方发行给政府以及任何希望参与的私人放贷方，并配以保证在价格下限下的承购。

sents.en: Its form changes with two externally observable conditions: the producer’s capacity build-out and Beijing’s behavior.
sents.zh: 其形式会随两个外部可观察的条件而变化：生产方的产能建设和北京的行为。

paragraphs.en: Here’s how it works. In its starting form (and in quiet years), a CoCo bond is a simple loan paying interest. Two triggers change its form. The first is capacity. The producer must cross a defined capacity threshold by a fixed date. Capacity can be measured as units of output in mining, refining, or manufacturing critical minerals. Management’s immediate incentives should be tied to the build-out itself.
paragraphs.zh: 其运作方式如下。 在初始形态下（以及在平静年份），应急可转换债券是一笔支付利息的简单贷款。 两个触发条件会改变其形态。第一个是产能。 生产商必须在固定日期前跨过既定的产能门槛。 产能可以按采矿、精炼或制造关键矿产的产出单位来衡量。 管理层的即时激励应当与建设本身挂钩。

sents.en: Here’s how it works.
sents.zh: 其运作方式如下。

sents.en: In its starting form (and in quiet years), a CoCo bond is a simple loan paying interest.
sents.zh: 在初始形态下（以及在平静年份），应急可转换债券是一笔支付利息的简单贷款。

sents.en: Two triggers change its form. The first is capacity.
sents.zh: 两个触发条件会改变其形态。第一个是产能。

sents.en: The producer must cross a defined capacity threshold by a fixed date.
sents.zh: 生产商必须在固定日期前跨过既定的产能门槛。

sents.en: Capacity can be measured as units of output in mining, refining, or manufacturing critical minerals.
sents.zh: 产能可以按采矿、精炼或制造关键矿产的产出单位来衡量。

sents.en: Management’s immediate incentives should be tied to the build-out itself.
sents.zh: 管理层的即时激励应当与建设本身挂钩。

paragraphs.en: The second trigger is either a sustained breach of an agreed price band or an externally observed exercise of the chokepoint. This could be denial of export licenses, a bureaucratic delay beyond a specified period, or another form of “constructive denial” that materially interrupts supply to the United States or allied countries. Importantly, no part of this trigger should rely on Beijing’s confirmation, because it is not incentivized to admit to a cutoff. The trigger should be narrow enough that it cannot be declared for political convenience, but broad enough that an adversary cannot game it simply by changing the form of the restriction.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个触发条件是商定价格区间的持续性突破，或者是外部观察到的对该咽喉要道的实际动用。 这可能是拒绝发放出口许可证、超出特定期限的官僚程序拖延，或其他形式的“建设性拒绝”，从而实质性地中断对美国或盟国的供应。 重要的是，该触发条件的任何部分都不应依赖北京方面的确认，因为北京没有承认切断供应的动机。 该触发条件应足够狭窄，以致不能出于政治便利而被宣布生效；同时又足够宽泛，以致对手无法仅通过改变限制的形式来规避它。

sents.en: The second trigger is either a sustained breach of an agreed price band or an externally observed exercise of the chokepoint.
sents.zh: 第二个触发条件是商定价格区间的持续性突破，或者是外部观察到的对该咽喉要道的实际动用。

sents.en: This could be denial of export licenses, a bureaucratic delay beyond a specified period, or another form of “constructive denial” that materially interrupts supply to the United States or allied countries.
sents.zh: 这可能是拒绝发放出口许可证、超出特定期限的官僚程序拖延，或其他形式的“建设性拒绝”，从而实质性地中断对美国或盟国的供应。

sents.en: Importantly, no part of this trigger should rely on Beijing’s confirmation, because it is not incentivized to admit to a cutoff.
sents.zh: 重要的是，该触发条件的任何部分都不应依赖北京方面的确认，因为北京没有承认切断供应的动机。

sents.en: The trigger should be narrow enough that it cannot be declared for political convenience, but broad enough that an adversary cannot game it simply by changing the form of the restriction.
sents.zh: 该触发条件应足够狭窄，以致不能出于政治便利而被宣布生效；同时又足够宽泛，以致对手无法仅通过改变限制的形式来规避它。

paragraphs.en: When the first trigger fires, the lender receives a pro rata share of the producer’s free cash flow, in effect, a dividend. The lender paid to build the capacity, so it shares in what that capacity earns. When both triggers fire, the lender also gains the right to convert into common equity. The conversion event does not create new capacity—the financing has already done that work—but rather matches the payoff to the risk. If lenders financed years of otherwise uneconomic capacity because a cutoff might someday make it necessary, they share in the upside if and when the cutoff comes. The cash participation matters too: In a crisis, the market may treat a price spike as temporary and event-driven and not value the equity, but the spike still flows through the producer’s cash flow, which benefits the lender either way.
paragraphs.zh: 当第一个触发条件被触发时，贷款人按比例分享生产商的自由现金流，实际上相当于一种分红。 贷款人为建设该产能支付了资金，因此可以分享该产能所获得的收益。 当两个触发条件同时被触发时，贷款人还将获得转换为普通股的权利。 该转换事件并不会创造新的产能——融资已经完成了这项工作——而是使回报与风险相匹配。 如果贷款人为原本不具经济性的产能提供了多年融资，因为某项禁令可能有一天使其成为必要，那么当禁令真的到来时，他们就分享其中的上行收益。 现金参与同样重要：在危机中，市场可能将价格飙升视为暂时性的、由事件驱动的现象，从而不对股权进行估值，但价格飙升仍然会传导到生产商的现金流中，无论哪种情况，贷款人都能从中受益。

sents.en: When the first trigger fires, the lender receives a pro rata share of the producer’s free cash flow, in effect, a dividend.
sents.zh: 当第一个触发条件被触发时，贷款人按比例分享生产商的自由现金流，实际上相当于一种分红。

sents.en: The lender paid to build the capacity, so it shares in what that capacity earns.
sents.zh: 贷款人为建设该产能支付了资金，因此可以分享该产能所获得的收益。

sents.zh: 当两个触发条件同时被触发时，贷款人还将获得转换为普通股的权利。

sents.zh: 该转换事件并不会创造新的产能——融资已经完成了这项工作——而是使回报与风险相匹配。

sents.en: If lenders financed years of otherwise uneconomic capacity because a cutoff might someday make it necessary, they share in the upside if and when the cutoff comes.
sents.zh: 如果贷款人为原本不具经济性的产能提供了多年融资，因为某项禁令可能有一天使其成为必要，那么当禁令真的到来时，他们就分享其中的上行收益。

sents.en: The cash participation matters too: In a crisis, the market may treat a price spike as temporary and event-driven and not value the equity, but the spike still flows through the producer’s cash flow, which benefits the lender either way.
sents.zh: 现金参与同样重要：在危机中，市场可能将价格飙升视为暂时性的、由事件驱动的现象，从而不对股权进行估值，但价格飙升仍然会传导到生产商的现金流中，无论哪种情况，贷款人都能从中受益。

paragraphs.en: Why would a producer agree to this? Because it gets something unique that the market will not otherwise provide. In effect, the producer buys a put—the price floor that carries it through Beijing’s dumping—and pays for it by selling a call—the cash share and the conversion right. It trades some of the windfall in a crisis for the protection of surviving quiet years. Either way, the taxpayer is paid for the risk actually borne, when it is borne, rather than for a risk merely feared.
paragraphs.zh: 生产者为什么会同意这种安排？ 因为它能获得市场上 otherwise 无法提供的某种独特之物。 实际上，生产者买入了一份看跌期权——即助其度过北京倾销的价格底线——并通过卖出一份看涨期权来支付代价——即现金分成和转换权。 它以让渡危机中的一部分意外之财，换取安然度过萧条年份的保护。 无论如何，纳税人都是为其实际承担的风险、在其承担之时获得补偿，而不是为仅仅被担忧的风险获得补偿。

sents.en: Why would a producer agree to this?
sents.zh: 生产者为什么会同意这种安排？

sents.en: Because it gets something unique that the market will not otherwise provide.
sents.zh: 因为它能获得市场上 otherwise 无法提供的某种独特之物。

sents.en: In effect, the producer buys a put—the price floor that carries it through Beijing’s dumping—and pays for it by selling a call—the cash share and the conversion right.
sents.zh: 实际上，生产者买入了一份看跌期权——即助其度过北京倾销的价格底线——并通过卖出一份看涨期权来支付代价——即现金分成和转换权。

sents.en: It trades some of the windfall in a crisis for the protection of surviving quiet years.
sents.zh: 它以让渡危机中的一部分意外之财，换取安然度过萧条年份的保护。

paragraphs.en: Nor does the government have to finance the entire CoCo bond. Pre-vetted private co-investors, including foreign co-investors subject to Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) screening, can offset government money dollar-for-dollar. Ideally, co-investors should be firms that fear a cutoff the most, such as defense contractors and automakers. Private co-investors would receive a pro rata right to offtake as a further incentive and could potentially even trade the bond with its associated offtake rights with other investors. Japan’s JARE consortium did something similar when it financed Australia’s Lynas in return for supply . Finally, private holders also give the program a constituency that outlasts any single administration.
paragraphs.zh: 政府也不必为全部的应急可转债提供融资。 经过预先审查的私人联合投资方，包括接受美国外国投资委员会（CFIUS）审查的外国联合投资方，可以与政府资金一比一配对出资。 理想情况下，联合投资方应是最担心供应中断的企业，例如国防承包商和汽车制造商。 私人联合投资方将获得按比例分配的承购权作为进一步激励，甚至有可能将该债券连同其附带的承购权一起转让给其他投资者。 日本的JARE财团在为澳大利亚莱纳斯公司提供融资以换取供应时就做过类似的事情。 最后，私人持有者也为该计划提供了一个比任何一届政府任期都更持久的支持群体。

sents.zh: 政府也不必为全部的应急可转债提供融资。

paragraphs.en: This instrument compensates for the asymmetric risk a lender (whether taxpayer or private) assumes when countering an adversary-controlled chokepoint, by providing an asymmetric reward if that chokepoint is ever exercised.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具通过在对方控制的咽喉要道被真正动用时提供非对称回报，来补偿贷款方（无论是纳税人还是私人）在应对对手控制的咽喉要道时所承担的非对称风险。

paragraphs.en: The risk here is not from a natural shortage or an ordinary price cycle, but from the Chinese Communist Party’s policy decisions. The same logic reaches other chokepoint materials such as pharmaceutical precursors. Rare earths are the clearest case and, at under $10 billion in market size, the cheapest place for the U.S. government to start. And it can start under existing authorities. For example, the Pentagon has leaned on Title III of the Defense Production Act for its recent mineral deals involving equity. The Pentagon’s Office of Strategic Capital can lend, but its equity authority remains unclear. The Senate is currently revising the National Defense Authorization Act for 2027 to clarify those authorities. Its language should cover instruments like this CoCo bond.
paragraphs.zh: 这里的风险并非来自自然短缺或普通的价格周期，而是来自中国共产党的政策决策。 同样的逻辑也适用于药物前体等其他咽喉材料。 稀土是最明显的案例，而且其市场规模不足100亿美元，是美国政府最容易着手的切入点。 而且它可以依据现有权限启动。 例如，五角大楼近期涉及股权的矿产交易就依托了《国防生产法》第三章。 五角大楼的战略资本办公室可以放贷，但其股权权限仍不明确。 参议院目前正在修订2027财年《国防授权法案》，以厘清这些权限。 相关条款应涵盖这种CoCo债券之类的工具。

sents.zh: 这里的风险并非来自自然短缺或普通的价格周期，而是来自中国共产党的政策决策。

sents.zh: 而且它可以依据现有权限启动。

sents.zh: 参议院目前正在修订2027财年《国防授权法案》，以厘清这些权限。

sents.en: Its language should cover instruments like this CoCo bond.
sents.zh: 相关条款应涵盖这种CoCo债券之类的工具。

paragraphs.en: Our CoCo bond proposal does not replace stockpiles, price floors, or offtake agreements. These instruments solve significant but different problems. Stockpiles buy time in a crisis, price floors protect producers against predatory pricing, and offtake agreements guarantee demand. The CoCo bond, in contrast, distributes risk and reward to investors in a binary, geopolitical event outside the producer’s control. It also enables the government to lend as a portfolio—some developers will fail, but the winners, and any crisis, can carry the portfolio as a whole. And it may have some deterrent effect as well: If this instrument makes capacity more likely to get built, and that prospect enters Beijing’s risk calculus, so much the better.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的应急可转换债券（CoCo bond）方案并不能取代战略储备、价格下限或承购协议。 这些工具解决的是重要但不同的问题。 战略储备在危机中争取时间，价格下限保护生产商免受掠夺性定价，承购协议则保障需求。 相比之下，应急可转换债券针对的是生产商无法控制的地缘政治二元事件，向投资者分配风险与回报。 它还使政府能够以投资组合的方式放贷——部分开发商会失败，但成功的项目以及任何一次危机，都能够支撑投资组合整体。 它还可能具有一定的威慑作用：如果这一工具使产能更有可能得到建设，而这一前景进入北京的风险考量之中，那就再好不过了。

sents.zh: 我们的应急可转换债券（CoCo bond）方案并不能取代战略储备、价格下限或承购协议。

paragraphs.en: Economically, the conversion right works like the equity warrants the Pentagon took in MP Materials . The difference lies in the quiet years, when under this structure the government holds no equity. Outright equity stakes invite the charge of nationalization; cheap financing with no upside smacks of corporate welfare. We believe a structure that is intentionally designed to avoid both at the outset—but flexible enough to change form in response to an adversary’s actions, not domestic political developments—has the best chance of surviving enough political cycles to complete a decade-plus build-out.
paragraphs.zh: 在经济上，这项转换权的作用类似于五角大楼在 MP Materials 交易中获得的股权认购权证。 区别在于那些平静的年份——在这种结构下，政府并不持有股权。 直接持有股权会招致国有化的指责；没有上行收益的廉价融资则带有企业福利的味道。 我们认为，一种在设计之初就刻意避开这两者——但又足够灵活，能根据对手的行动而非国内政治变化而改变形式——的结构，最有机会跨越足够多的政治周期，完成长达十年以上的建设。

sents.zh: 在经济上，这项转换权的作用类似于五角大楼在 MP Materials 交易中获得的股权认购权证。

paragraphs.en: Translating this concept into reality raises important implementation questions about statutory authority, precise trigger definitions, CFIUS integration, and corporate governance. We offer the CoCo bond model to stimulate discussions around aligning interests in a market failure and national security context, and we invite the legal, policy, and financial communities to help refine the “plumbing” necessary to make asymmetric financing a workable pillar of U.S. statecraft.
paragraphs.zh: 将这一概念转化为现实，引出了关于法定授权、触发条件精确定义、与 CFIUS 的整合以及公司治理等重要实施问题。 我们提出 CoCo 债券模型，旨在激发关于在市场失灵与国家安全背景下协调各方利益的讨论，并邀请法律界、政策界和金融界共同完善必要的“管道设施”，使非对称融资成为美国治国方略中切实可行的一大支柱。

sents.en: Translating this concept into reality raises important implementation questions about statutory authority, precise trigger definitions, CFIUS integration, and corporate governance.
sents.zh: 将这一概念转化为现实，引出了关于法定授权、触发条件精确定义、与 CFIUS 的整合以及公司治理等重要实施问题。

sents.en: We offer the CoCo bond model to stimulate discussions around aligning interests in a market failure and national security context, and we invite the legal, policy, and financial communities to help refine the “plumbing” necessary to make asymmetric financing a workable pillar of U.S. statecraft.
sents.zh: 我们提出 CoCo 债券模型，旨在激发关于在市场失灵与国家安全背景下协调各方利益的讨论，并邀请法律界、政策界和金融界共同完善必要的“管道设施”，使非对称融资成为美国治国方略中切实可行的一大支柱。

paragraphs.en: A market will always sell a chokepoint to whoever runs it cheapest, and by market logic, it would be the right thing to do. Subsidies alone cannot win it back, because they only affect price; Beijing prices for geopolitical leverage, not profit. Neutralizing a chokepoint created through market failure requires capital willing to absorb years of subpar returns or even losses against an extraordinary geopolitical crisis. In quiet years, the government should earn like a lender, with the price floor protecting against Beijing’s dumping. When capacity is built, it should share in what it financed. And if Beijing ever reaches for the switch, the taxpayers and private investors who paid to insure against that moment should participate in the value their capital created. The risk is asymmetric. The financing should be too.
paragraphs.zh: 市场总会把咽喉要道卖给运营成本最低的人，而按照市场逻辑，这么做才是正确的。 仅靠补贴无法夺回它，因为补贴只能影响价格；而北京定价是为了地缘政治杠杆，不是为了利润。 要化解一个因市场失灵而形成的咽喉要道，需要有资本愿意承受多年低于正常水平的回报甚至亏损，以应对一场非同寻常的地缘政治危机。 在平静的年份里，政府应像放贷人一样获利，由价格下限防范北京的倾销。 当产能建成时，出资方应分享其资助的成果。 而如果北京真的伸手去按那个开关，那些为防范这一时刻而付出代价的纳税人和私人投资者，就应分享他们的资本所创造的价值。风险是不对称的。 融资安排也应该是不对称的。
